name: Training Grounds
description: A yard where martial companions drill between runs. Each tier opens a stance slot to learn in, and the veteran floor sets what kind of soldiers the guild raises.

tiers.description: Martials learn a first stance here, and drill: +1 action point for Fighters, +2 for Rangers.
A second stance slot to learn in.

A third stance slot and +1 action point. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. Levy Muster: a martial whose weapon teaches no maneuvers drills Brace, and garrisons raise militia a moon sooner. Or the Proving Grounds: a martial carries a second weapon and changes to it mid-fight.

doctrines.name: Levy Muster
doctrines.description: Wide martials. A martial whose weapon teaches no maneuvers (an unclassed blade, or a class whose maneuvers are not written yet) drills Brace instead. Garrisons raise their militia after 2 moons instead of 3.

doctrines.name: The Proving Grounds
doctrines.description: Tall martials. A martial may carry a second weapon and change to it in a fight for 1 AP, taking its class, maneuvers and attack. Stance finishers at 5 Edge are still to come.
